Ashfield weekly - week ending 11/07/2025

PM: J. Patel

PROGRAMME
Baseline energisation 14/11/2025
Current forecast 28/11/2025
Float: zero, in delay

PROGRESS
Commissioning preparation is under way. Mechanical and electrical
installation remain complete.

ISSUES
DNO connection works date of 10/11/2025 now confirmed in writing
by the account manager, following the formal escalation. This still
leaves no contingency before the 14/11 energisation baseline, and
the forecast of 28/11 relies on the works finishing on time. A request
to bring the works forward has gone to the account manager; no answer yet.

Switchroom cable entry snagging is still outstanding. The contractor
has not given a return date. It has been open since week 19.

Commercial implication: capacity market delivery start is 01/12/2025.
The 28/11 forecast leaves three days. Any further slip puts the
delivery start at risk.

ACTIONS
- Chase the DNO account manager for an answer on bringing the works forward
- Contractor to give a return date for the switchroom snagging
